---
title: "Farms and farmers"
description: "Types of farm, the age of farmers, dairy farms by county, and organic farming."
---

There were 133,174 farms in Ireland in 2023. Most raise cattle. More than half were specialist beef farms, and beef, sheep, dairy and mixed livestock farms together made up 86% of all farms.

{{< chart agriculture-farm-types >}}

## Who farms

In 2023, 38% of farm holders were aged 65 or over, and 4% were under 35. The average age of a farm holder rose from 51 in 2000 to 57 in 2020.

{{< chart agriculture-holder-age >}}

## Dairy farms by county

Dairy farming is concentrated in the south. In 2020, more than a quarter of farms in Cork and Waterford were dairy farms, compared with 1% in Leitrim.

{{< chart agriculture-dairy-map >}}

## Organic farming

A small share of Ireland's farmland is farmed organically. In 2024, 5.0% of farmed land was organic or being converted to organic, among the lowest shares in the EU.

{{< chart agriculture-organic-eu >}}
